full_judgment:
Shahidul Islam, J: This First Appeal has been presented by the defendant Nos. 1-8 against the impugned judgment and decree dated 5-6-2004 passed by the learned Joint District Judge-in-charge. 2nd Court, Chittagong in Other Class Suit No. 143 of 2001 decreeing the suit against the defendant No. 7 and 8.on contest and exparte against the rest and declaring that the plaintiff respondent Nos. 1-17 are entitled to get lease of the plot/property in their favour with the valuation presently Taka 6 Lakh per bigha. 

 24. In the result, the appeal is allowed without any order as to costs. The impugned judgment and decree dated 5-6-2004 passed by the learned Joint District Judge-in-charge, 2nd Court, Chittagong in Other Class Suit No. 143 of 2001 are hereby set aside. The suit is dismissed without any order as to costs.
